name: background-http-server
description: Write an HTML-parsing server, run it in background, test via curl. Full background lifecycle.
task: Write a tiny Python HTTP server (using the http.server module) that accepts POST requests with HTML body, parses them with justhtml, and responds with the text content. Run it in the background on port 9876, curl it with a sample HTML body to prove it works, then shut everything down. Save the curl response to curl_result.txt.
